responsibility: Implements the AArch64 target’s common option layer: it sets architecture-specific optimization defaults, records and validates command-line selections such as -march, -mcpu, -mtune, alignment and erratum flags in gcc_options, and provides driver-side rewriting of -mcpu into assembler-facing -march strings. A central responsibility of the file is maintaining the AArch64 ISA extension registry and the logic that parses, canonicalizes, and re-emits feature-extension strings based on architecture defaults, so later backend code sees normalized CPU, tuning, and feature state rather than raw option text.
